trial_type.Description: trial = one change-detection trial (intervals/trials); fixation/memory/retention/probe = trial periods (intervals/epochs tags); response = button press (BehavioralEvents.response).

set_size.Description: Number of coloured squares in the memory array (1, 2, 4 or 6).

solution.Description: Correct answer: same = test array identical to the memory array; different = one square changed colour.

source_table.Description: NWB table the row comes from.

source_row_id.Description: Row id in that NWB table.

sample.Description: Sample index of onset (0-based) at the recording's sampling frequency.
